Exchanges.Text: Good morning, Gate team-b. Our sprint goal is “Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically,” and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, for story 3, story 4, task 15, and task 19, are those done as you committed once the idempotency keys were in? Also, what did you finish, what’s next, are you blocked, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, the Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment and that you have nothing blocking you.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Daniel, for the summary page being paused until the idempotency keys are in, who can help unblock this?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel—Maya, are story 2 validation, story 5 follow-up, and bug 12 pairing done?
What did you finish, what’s next, and are you blocked?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline; I’ll add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for your blocker on bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timeouts and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.; blocker: Staging access is needed., and the blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment, and it will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.
Admin, is story 1 done from your earlier commitment, and is task 14 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the task that slipped because the sandbox was down and you expect to finish it tomorrow, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: need to sync with Maya after stand-up about the sandbox, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: Daniel is on track and will pick the summary page back up once idempotency keys are in; Maya is blocked on bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway; the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review; the sandbox was down; and there’s a sync needed with Maya after stand-up about the sandbox. A side discussion about gateway timeouts between Daniel Park and Admin has been parked for offline. task 19 was not covered and is flagged as stale, at risk, with a missed commitment, so its owners will get a follow-up. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
